x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given the connector or push integration for a tool is configured, When the tool raises an alert, Then an em_event is created within the agreed latency Given a connector fails, When the next poll runs, Then the connector status shows the error and the operations team is notified
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Events from in-scope monitoring tools are ingested into Event Management
